title: Canny → Fider
summary: Make Fider the easiest credible path away from closed product-feedback software—without fragmenting the project or claiming maintainer approval before it exists.
statusNote: Maintainer direction requested publicly in Fider discussion #1649; response pending. No feature implementation begins until the proposal follows Fider's contribution process and the relevant scope is accepted.
exitMetric: Three verified Canny migrations and one paying hosted customer.
proofPoints: Canny supports CSV exports for posts and separate voter exports, creating a bounded migration input.
Fider is an active AGPL project with a current release and an established contribution process.
The mission can prove value through migration and deployment work before proposing broad feature parity.

phases.title: Align before code
deliverables: Share the mission charter with Fider maintainers
Confirm the correct upstream channel and architectural constraints
Recruit one Canny design partner with a real export
phases.exitGate: Maintainer direction recorded and one representative export available

phases.title: Prove the migration
deliverables: Document Canny-to-Fider field and status mapping
Build a dry-run validator with an explicit loss report
Test posts, tags, authors, voters, comments, and attachments separately
phases.exitGate: Design partner approves a dry-run migration report

phases.title: Contribute upstream
deliverables: Implement only work accepted through Fider's process
Add regression coverage and operator documentation
Keep optional migration tooling separable when appropriate
phases.exitGate: Accepted implementation path with named long-term ownership

phases.title: Move real teams
deliverables: Publish anonymized migration outcomes and unresolved gaps
phases.exitGate: Three migrations and one paying hosted customer
